//cleanupPeriodDays: Pinned explicitly so an upstream default change doesn't alter /resume history
//maxProseWidth: Min. 40. Text wraps at this many columns; tables and code blocks keep the full width. 100 instead of 80 because long sentences wrapped too often on a wide terminal
//prStatusFooterEnabled: Keep true: custom PR indicator depends on it
//terminalTitleFromRename: /rename and --name would otherwise still change the terminal tab title
//agentPushNotifEnabled: Sometimes they're useful. Just learn to ignore them
//keybindingFlavor: It was not deleting word by word
//remoteControlAtStartup: Sometimes it fails at the worst time and blocks the session
